hypothesis: Some attention heads may write excess false-token support on explicit human acts. Inspect their activations and output matrices, then test targeted output-column ablation without gradients.
method: Approximate head-output logit attribution to nominate two candidates; exact causal head-output column edits; no optimizer, LoRA or backward passes.
selection: Choose one of the two distinct top-attribution heads by diagnostic balanced binary log-loss after full ablation; select before validation/test generation. Never select or retune on the new test.
control: Next head modulo eight in the same layer as the selected head; equal column count, not claimed norm-matched.
gate: Research retention requires >=20/24 fresh complete proposal outcomes, >=4 gains over matched base, no fresh copied/injection false report, and no control-prompt regression. No live promotion on agent-authored labels.
privacy: Invented packets only; no private records, model upload, production blob writes or foreground app tests.
notReplication: Adapted component-inspection/causal-intervention experiment on Gemma classification, not reproduction of the Qwen looping result.
